caseName: D. E. Foote & Co. v. Harrington
caseNameFull: D. E. Foote & Company, Inc., in Error v. Emerson C. Harrington, Governor of the State of Maryland
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Maryland.
attorneys: Mr. George Whitelock for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Ogle Mafbury and Mr. Albert C. Ritchie for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Eustis v. Bolles, 150 U. S. 361; Leathe v. Thomas, 207 U. S. 93; Holden Land Co. v. Inter-State Trading Co., 233 U. S. 536, 541; Bilby v. Stewart, ante, 255.
